items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I'm Dick Allen. All right? Now, proceed with the questions.

ctx.x: Is there a possibility that these arrangements which they made are still in the hands of some of these men or their families in your audience?
I wonder. That's what that's... It would certainly be interesting to get your hands on, Dick.
Well we got, we got, we bought the Rovershaw collection.
